krishna: Lord Krishna as Arjuna's charioteer: luminous blue-hued skin, serene compassionate face, peacock-feather crown of gold and jewels, yellow silk pitambara, garland of forest flowers, holding the chariot reins or a flute; calm, dignified, never smiling mockingly
arjuna: Arjuna, Pandava warrior prince: athletic build, dark long hair under a gold crown, bronze and gold armour over white dhoti, the great Gandiva bow and quiver; face shifting from anguish to resolve
chariot: Arjuna's war chariot: ornate gold and white, four white horses, banner bearing Hanuman, wheels spoked and carved
sanjaya: Sanjaya, the royal narrator: elderly wise man in cream robes, eyes glowing faintly with divine vision, in a dim palace hall
dhritarashtra: Dhritarashtra, the blind Kuru king: aged, grey beard, ornate throne, unseeing eyes, anxious posture
kurukshetra: Kurukshetra battlefield at dawn: two vast armies facing each other, saffron and white banners, conches, dust and haze, sun rising between them
